spans.s: muṇḍā (Skt. Lex. id.), shaveling woman, contemptuous ep. of a Buddhist nun (cf. muṇḍaka, ˚ika): Kalpanāmaṇḍitikā, Lüders, Kl. Skt. Texte 2, 〔44〕.
muṇḍanā (= Skt. and Pali muṇḍana, nt.), clipping of the hair: Mvy 〔9332〕 = Tib. skra breg(s).
muṇḍāpayati (caus. to Skt. muṇḍayati, Pali muṇḍeti; = AMg. muṇḍāvei), causes to be shaved: ˚payitvā Divy 〔261.15〕.
muṇḍi, f. (perh. muṇḍī Deśīn 〔6.133〕 = Skt. nīraṅgī), veil (?): puṣpalokamayīṃ (? see puṣpaloka) muṇḍiṃ lakṣaṇopetāṃ kṛtvā, paṭasyāgrataḥ kṛtapuraścaraṇaḥ … Mmk 〔691.25〕.
